changelog:
Initial release of Nano Banana 2 — Pro Pack for RunComfy.

- Enables text-to-image generation using Google’s Nano Banana 2 model via the RunComfy CLI.
- Supports rapid iteration, stable image framing, and in-image typography rendering.
- Optional web-grounded context (`enable_web_search`) for real-time, event-referenced image generation.
- Includes configurable parameters: image count, aspect ratio, resolution, output format, safety tolerance, random seed, and more.
- Triggers on multiple keyword variants related to Nano Banana and Gemini image.
display_name: Nano Banana 2 — Pro Pack on RunComfy
summary: Nano Banana 2 on RunComfy. Nano Banana 2 is Google's flash-tier text-to-image model in the Gemini family — fast iteration, predictable framing, in-image typography rendering, optional web-grounded context. This skill calls Nano Banana 2 through the RunComfy CLI: `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/text-to-image`. Nano Banana 2 is the right Nano Banana variant for marketing drafts, social thumbnails, and batch variants. Triggers on "nano banana", "nano-banana", "nano banana 2", "nano-banana-2", "Google Nano Banana", "Gemini image", or any explicit ask to generate with Nano Banana.
